description: CR 605.1a conjuring into a library keeps an ability that adds mana off the mana path
note: docs/decisions.md, "Whether conjuring into a library is a library move for a mana ability". Synthetic Seeded Grove's {T} ability adds {G} and conjures a Forest onto the top of alice's library. Parun reads the conjure as a move into a library, so CR 605.1a's last criterion fails, the ability is no mana ability, and it uses the stack (CR 605.3b's immediate resolution is a mana ability's alone), and the priority prompt offers it as an ordinary activation. The rejected reading, that a conjured card moves nowhere, would make it a mana ability and leave the stack empty. Synthetic because no printing conjures inside an ability that could add mana: MTGJSON AtomicCards of 2026-10-08 and Scryfall `o:conjure (o:"add {" or o:"add one" or o:"add two" or o:"add three" or o:"add an amount" or o:"add x")`, 2026-10-19, find only cards whose conjure and whose mana are separate abilities.
